name: TET Japanese SEO Writer
author: tetphilosopher1

sections.description:
TET Japanese SEO Writer generates Japanese SEO articles from your WordPress dashboard. Enter a topic and the plugin creates a complete draft post with a title, headings, body text, and meta description.

Features

  • Enter a topic and get a full article saved as a WordPress draft (title, headings, body, meta description)
  • Research mode (paid plans): the AI searches the web for up-to-date information before writing, and appends a list of cited sources to the article
  • Writes the meta description and focus keyword for Yoast SEO and Rank Math automatically
  • Four writing tones (professional, casual, educational, SEO-focused) and target length from 1,500 to 4,000 characters
  • Articles are always saved as drafts, never published automatically, so you can review and edit before publishing

Free tier

Register your email address from the settings screen to receive a free API key (3 articles per month, standard generation). Paid plans (30 to 300 articles per month, research mode) are available on the official site.

Note: Generated articles are written in Japanese. The service is currently aimed at Japanese-language sites.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external “AIC API” (operated by TET Inc., https://tetphilosopher.com/aic/) to generate articles.

Data sent to the service:

  • When generating an article: the topic, target audience, keywords, and tone settings you enter
  • When validating a key or requesting a free key: your API key, or the email address you enter

No other data — such as your site’s posts or user information — is ever sent.

  • Terms of service: https://tetphilosopher.com/aic/terms.html
  • Privacy policy: https://tetphilosopher.com/aic/privacy.html
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open “AI記事生成 > 設定” (AI Article Generation > Settings) and enter your API key. A free key can be requested from the same screen.
  3. Open the “AI記事生成” (AI Article Generation) screen, enter a topic, and click the generate button.
sections.faq:
Is there a free plan?

Yes. Register your email address to generate up to 3 articles per month for free (research mode is a paid feature).

Can I use the generated articles commercially?

Yes, you are free to use generated articles on your own sites, including for commercial purposes.

Are articles published automatically?

No. Articles are always saved as drafts. Review and publish them yourself.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

The plugin writes the meta description and focus keyword for Yoast SEO and Rank Math.

What language are articles written in?

Articles are generated in Japanese.
